evidence.summary: Historical first occurrence: KDP-ready state was reached before a complete final commercial package existed.
Second occurrence: price existed in some RN5 production artifacts but the reusable gate did not require a final pricing section and consistent recommendation across every upload artifact.

details.root_cause: The prior validation boundary checked package presence and versions but not final-price completeness and cross-artifact consistency.

evidence.summary: The final 8 x 10, 58-page paperback is priced at $16.99 on Amazon.com after current substitute and KDP economics verification.

decisions.reason: The price remains inside the visible adjacent shelf while reflecting the higher buyer utility of a proposal-decoding and write-in decision system; fixed print cost and 60% royalty yield approximately $7.35.
